def test_workdir_none_falls_back_to_cwd(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
        result = execute_tool("write_file", {"path": "c.txt", "content": "y"})
        assert "成功" in result
        assert (tmp_path / "c.txt").exists()

    def test_llm_cannot_override_workdir_when_none(self, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # workdir 注入为 None（CLI/MCP 场景）时，LLM 传入的 workdir 也必须被剥离，
        # 否则可越界写到任意路径。
        monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
        result = execute_tool(
            "write_file",
            {"path": "d.txt", "content": "z", "workdir": "/nonexistent-xyz"},
        )
        assert "成功" in result
        assert (tmp_path / "d.txt").exists()
        assert not Path("/nonexistent-xyz/d.txt").exists()
